description: Luckfox Lyra Plus physical target running RK3506/Buildroot (armv7l) with BusyBox init, real GPIO/SPI devices, and SSH deployment.

backendNotes.simulator: Use the linux-device runtime on an ARM64 SSH simulation host.
backendNotes.target: Deploy to the physical Lyra Plus over an SSH config Host. The board runs Buildroot with BusyBox init rather than systemd.
backendNotes.media: Use the RK3506 Buildroot media stack available in the selected board image.
backendNotes.hardware: Board resources and kernel interfaces are described by hardware/capabilities.json; product wiring is a product-owned Target binding.
backendNotes.prepare: Run gar target prepare once to install the constrained Buildroot deploy helper and BusyBox init template.
